settings.title: We believe that true quality lies in the details.
settings.content:
Each of our products is expertly handcrafted in our Missouri-based workshop, ensuring unparalleled craftsmanship and durability. We source only the finest natural materials and combine them with our innovative FireLight technology to create saunas that are both beautiful and functional.

Experience the difference of a product made with care. Our commitment to quality means you can enjoy the benefits of light and heat therapy with confidence, knowing your SaunaSpace is built to support your wellness journey for years to come.

settings.title: Sustainably Harvested Basswood
settings.content:
Sourced from responsibly managed American forests, basswood is a lightweight hardwood with a creamy tone, fine grain, and subtle, honeyed scent. Long used in herbal traditions for its calming properties, it brings a sense of warmth and quiet beauty to your space.

Each piece is hand-shaped and sanded to a velvety finish by skilled makers, then left completely untreated—free of stains, sealers, or synthetics—to preserve the purity of the wood and the integrity of your sanctuary. A time-honored material, reborn for modern healing.
settings.content_mobile: Sourced from responsibly managed American forests, basswood is a creamy, fine-grained hardwood with a subtle honeyed scent. Each piece is hand-shaped and sanded to a velvety finish, then left completely untreated to preserve its purity.

settings.title: Organic Bamboo
settings.content:
Used in our grounding sauna mats, this kiln-toasted bamboo is smooth, durable, and naturally antimicrobial. The toasting process enhances its strength and gives it a warm, caramel tone—without chemical treatments or synthetic finishes.

Bamboo’s resistance to moisture and microbial growth makes it ideal for the warm, dry environment of the sauna. With a grounding feel underfoot and a clean, refined surface, it supports your practice with strength, clarity, and ease.
settings.content_mobile: Smooth and unfinished, our kiln-toasted organic bamboo is naturally antimicrobial, moisture-resistant, and free of chemical treatments. Its warm caramel tone and grounded feel make it the perfect surface for clean, supportive, barefoot sauna sessions.

settings.title: Organic Cotton Canvas
settings.content:
Woven from 100% certified organic cotton, our canvas forms the clean, breathable enclosure of the sauna. Undyed, unbleached, and untreated, it’s completely free from VOCs, synthetic coatings, and flame retardants.

The natural weight and texture of the canvas create a sense of cocooning, providing a safe, grounding container for your daily ritual. Because it breathes with you, it supports airflow and temperature regulation without off-gassing or static buildup.
settings.content_mobile: Woven from 100% certified organic cotton, our undyed, unbleached canvas is free of VOCs and synthetics. Its breathable weight creates a grounding, cocoon-like space that supports airflow and temperature regulation—naturally clean, safe, and calming.

settings.title: Low-Impact Dyes
settings.content:
Most of our textiles are colored using low-impact dyes—safer for your skin and the environment than conventional chemical dyes, and free from harsh fixatives or heavy metals.

For select pieces, we use a turmeric-based dye inspired by Ayurvastra, the ancient Ayurvedic practice of infusing cloth with medicinal herbs. Turmeric is known for its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and energetically purifying properties. This golden hue is more than just a color—it’s a nod to the healing intelligence of nature, woven into every thread.
settings.content_mobile: We use low-impact dyes free from harsh fixatives and heavy metals. Select pieces are turmeric-dyed, inspired by Ayurvastra—an ancient tradition of infusing cloth with healing herbs. Naturally antimicrobial, this golden hue brings beauty, purity, and intention.

settings.title: Antimicrobial Silver
settings.content:
Woven into our optional SilverLining™ shield, ultra-fine threads of pure silver form a conductive mesh that grounds ambient EMFs and protects your healing space. Silver has been used for centuries for its natural antimicrobial and purifying qualities—it inhibits the growth of bacteria, fungi, and other pathogens without any chemical coatings.

The result: a cleaner, clearer environment that protects your body’s subtle electrical systems while enhancing the therapeutic field of the sauna.
settings.content_mobile: Our optional SilverLining™ shield weaves ultra-fine silver threads into a conductive mesh that grounds ambient EMFs, creating a truly EMF-free interior. This reduces cellular stress and supports deeper detox. Naturally antimicrobial, silver keeps the space clean and clear.

settings.title: Non-Toxic Stainless Steel
settings.content: All hardware is made from uncoated, medical-grade stainless steel—free from aluminum, paints, plastics, and synthetic coatings. We use no glues, no composites, and no hidden materials. Just clean, hypoallergenic strength that won’t off-gas or break down over time. Built for purity. Designed to last.
settings.content_mobile: All hardware is uncoated, medical-grade stainless steel—no aluminum, paints, plastics, or glues. Free from synthetics and off-gassing, it offers clean, hypoallergenic strength that won’t degrade over time. Nothing hidden. Everything built to last.

settings.title: Proprietary FireLight® Bulb
settings.content:
At the core of every SaunaSpace experience is the FireLight® Bulb—our signature innovation, shaped by over a decade of R&D. Hand-blown from pure quartz-stained glass, it delivers a finely tuned spectrum that peaks in red and near-infrared for maximum light therapy, while extending into mid- and far-infrared for deeply effective heat.

This full-spectrum design captures the most healing wavelengths of the sun—without the harmful ones—activating cellular repair, detoxification, and full-body rejuvenation. Built for longevity and performance, each bulb offers thousands of hours of radiant therapy and comes backed by a five-year warranty. This isn’t just a bulb. It’s the light that transforms.
settings.content_mobile: The FireLight® Bulb is our signature innovation—quartz-stained, precisely engineered for optimal light and heat therapy. Its full-spectrum glow spans red to far-infrared, delivering deep warmth that supports cellular repair, detox, and radiant rejuvenation.

settings.title: What does GOTS certification mean?
settings.content: GOTS certification stands for Global Organic Textile Standard. It is one of the most widely recognized and trusted certifications for organic textiles. GOTS ensures a high standard for sustainability and ethical production. It goes beyond just the organic status of raw materials and evaluates the entire production process. Learn more about GOTS certification.

settings.title: Are our materials hypoallergenic?
settings.content: Yes! All materials we use are hypoallergenic. Basswood is one of the few types of wood known for its hypoallergenic properties and is a key component of our saunas. Making our sauna an excellent choice for individuals with allergies or sensitivities.

settings.title: How do we EMF shield our products?
settings.content: We’ve taken specific measures to ensure your experience is EMF-free! Every panel we produce is internally and externally shielded and grounded. Thanks to our advanced wiring practices, grounding techniques, and specialized bulb guards, our customers experience ZERO electric or magnetic stress from our panels. Our power cords are also e-shielded, offering an added layer of protection.

settings.title: Where are our products made?
settings.content: All our products are crafted by hand at our Columbia, MO USA production shop.
